template_counts_and_definitions.abstract_core_intents_definition: Core sentence after stripping greetings/closings and replacing product with {PRODUCT}. (4 intents per category * 6 categories = 24 intents).
template_counts_and_definitions.core_sentence_templates_definition: Core sentence after stripping greetings/closings, retaining specific product name. (24 intents * 8 products = 192 templates).
template_counts_and_definitions.abstract_templates_definition: Sentence after replacing product with {PRODUCT}, numbers with {NUM}, greetings with {GREETING}, sign-offs with {SIGN_OFF}, retaining specific prefixes/suffixes (680 distinct forms across dataset; 660 in test split, all seen in train).

priority_assignment_rule_audit.rule_description: Feedback & Product Inquiry -> Low; Account & Shipping -> Medium; Technical Issue & Billing -> Urgent if ('urgent' or 'asap' in message) else High
